title: Golar LNG Limited - Announcement of filing of Form 20-F Annual Report
summary: Golar LNG Limited announces that it has filed its Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025, with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the U.S. ...
body_markdown:
Golar LNG Limited announces that it has filed its Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025, with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the U.S.


Form 20-F can be downloaded from the link below, is available on our website[www.golarlng.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-oWKWf99WzodNfxvNahh3IpOx_lZAmASjsUHIHUrPgnvwcYZFsGI7QcoY0TF128riXad1AuUbfYzowwZrVOtC5GwaAqqdmineDdHVd80CTg=) and shareholders may receive a hard copy free of charge upon request.


March 26, 2026
The Board of Directors
Hamilton, Bermuda


This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section 5-12 the Norwegian Securities Trading Act
